backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the QuickRepair backend, implementing user profile management, feedback/rating storage, and admin operations with role-based access control via AccessControl and MixinAuthorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (UI removals, footer link addition, etc.) to their affected source files, component dependencies, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and recent changes of every component, hook, page, and config file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, card, border, chart, and sidebar color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the QuickRepair app, including Google site verification, AdSense meta tags, preconnect hints for ICP endpoints, and a LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema with service offerings and area coverage.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up React Query, implements pathname-based client-side routing, and lazy-loads below-fold sections; routes include admin, booking, booking history, mechanic registration, terms, and the main site layout with a FloatingCallButton.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the 'About Us' section with a text description of QuickRepair and a 2x2 grid of highlight cards (response time, verified pros, pricing, coverage) using a fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx: Password-protected admin dashboard that lets admins view/delete users and feedback, and manage services (add/edit/delete) and mechanic registrations via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormSecti: Booking form section that requires Internet Identity authentication; on submission it posts form data to FormSubmit, plays a success sound, and shows a confirmation overlay.
frontend/src/components/BookingSuccessOv: Full-screen portal overlay that displays an animated SVG checkmark and 'Booking Confirmed' message, auto-dismissing after 2.8 seconds or on user tap.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Displays contact information (phone, email, working hours) and a list of service areas in a two-column card layout with fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with nine questions about QuickRepair's services, rendered with animated expand/collapse per item and a fade-in section entrance.
Displays a customer feedback/reviews section with sample and live reviews fetched via React Query hooks, and includes a form for submitting new star-rated feedback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Renders a fixed floating call button linking to a phone number with a gradient style and 'Call Now' label.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Renders a fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with logo, navigation links, a booking button, copyright notice, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders a sticky header with logo, navigation, Internet Identity login/logout, user profile dropdown, and a profile setup modal triggered when no profile exists.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Renders the full-screen hero section with animated headline, tagline, CTA buttons, and trust-indicator badges for the QuickRepair landing page.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Displays a three-step 'How It Works' process section with icons, connector lines, and fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/NavigationDrawer: A slide-in mobile navigation drawer that highlights the active section via scroll spy, shows nav links, and conditionally renders Booking History for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/Overlay.tsx: A full-screen semi-transparent backdrop component used to dim content behind the mobile navigation drawer, toggled by isOpen prop.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: A modal form for collecting and registering a user's name, phone number, and service area, using the useRegisterUser mutation hook with validation.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: A card component displaying a single service with its icon, description, starting price, and a Book Online button that navigates to /booking.
A section that fetches and displays service cards from the backend, falling back to hardcoded services if none are returned, with a loading spinner during fetch.
frontend/src/components/TrustStatsBar.ts: A horizontal stats bar displaying three trust indicators (happy customers, response time, star rating) with fade-in animation on scroll.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts: A hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when the referenced element scrolls into view, enabling CSS fade-in animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for all backend interactions including feedback CRUD, user profile management, admin checks, bookings, services, and mechanic registration. Uses a delayed-ready pattern for feedback queries to improve initial page paint performance.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Custom hook that tracks which section is currently in view by comparing scroll position against section element offsets, returning the active section ID.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Inter/Poppins fonts and Tailwind, defining CSS custom properties for the dark theme, and declaring animations for fade-in, service card hover, pulse ring, and a GPay-style booking success overlay.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/BookingHistoryPage.ts: Page that displays a user's past bookings sorted newest-first, showing date, time, service ID, address, and phone for each booking, with authentication gating via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: Booking form page that submits service requests via FormSubmit, shows a GPay-style success overlay with sound on completion, and requires Internet Identity authentication before displaying the form.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicRegistrationP: Mechanic registration form page with client-side validation that submits applicant details to the backend via a mutation hook and displays a GPay-style success overlay with a portal on successful submission.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the Terms and Policies page for QuickRepair, displaying sections covering response time, service guarantee, pricing, service area, and customer feedback in a dark-themed layout.
frontend/src/utils/playSuccessSound.ts: Provides a utility function that plays a Google Pay-style ascending C-E-G major chord arpeggio using the Web Audio API to signal a successful action.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, brand colors, surface palette, box shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations for the frontend application.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state including version, existing implemented features, known issues, and pending feature requests for the QuickRepair website.
